description: Append-only ledger of concluded hypothesis families (WP-4). Each record closes one approach — a canonicalized lever-key family — after enough adequately powered failures under policy conclusion_policy. A closed approach NEVER closes a goal (AGENTS.md I14): goal invariants stay open and reopen conditions are recorded on every entry. Entries are content-addressed and never rewritten or deleted.
